text: am-smtp describes passwordCleartext differently when socketType is SSL or alwaysSTARTTLS. The 731 alias cleanup preserves that condition. A cleartext authentication method name alone does not determine whether this settings UI should display the insecure label. This source finding does not validate a live TLS negotiation.
title: Keep the SMTP password label conditional on transport security
